headline: A 2008 executive order meant to help the handoff of power from President Bush to the next president.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order sets up steps to make the change from one president's administration to the next go smoothly. It was signed about a month before the 2008 presidential election. No summary was provided, so the specific steps it requires are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies and executive branch officials
who_it_affects.how: They were likely directed to help prepare for and support the transfer of duties to the incoming administration.
They were likely the people receiving help and information from the outgoing administration.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed October 9, 2008; executive orders usually take effect when signed.
